hook: Your calendar in Samoa once skipped a whole day.
title: Samoa deleted 30 December 2011
description:
On 29 December 2011 Samoa went to bed on a Thursday and woke up on Saturday. The country moved across the International Date Line to line up with Australia and New Zealand. Friday 30 December never happened there.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
comment_prompt: Would you skip a day? Yes or no
